oracle.scope: Directed mathematical intervals supply the oracle; mpmath agreement is an independent numerical cross-check. Exhaustive scalar encodings are separate from tensor indexing and GPU specialization checks.
oracle.method: For a=|x|, enclose 1+a*a, its square root, and a/sqrt(1+a*a) with directed MPFR rounding. Division pairs the lower numerator with the upper denominator and conversely. Negating the interval handles negative inputs.
oracle.candidate_independence: The oracle uses mathematical square root and division, not the candidates' bit seed, Newton steps, constants, or arithmetic helpers.

indexing.argument: For index=program_id*BLOCK+lane, adjacent blocks cover disjoint adjacent intervals. mask index<N retains [0,N) exactly once. The full legal N range has 1..BLOCK active lanes in its last block, with int32-safe address indices.
indexing.scope: Arithmetic model of the audited source indexing, not exhaustive GPU testing of every N, address, or compiler specialization.

cpu_audit.scope: Full finite-FP16 scalar reference audit, distinct from GPU arithmetic and tensor-property qualification.
